text.description: the text; line breaks start new lines

font.description: font asset whose outlines are extruded; content path of a font asset (no extension)

size.description: height of a line (ascent plus descent); unit: m

depth.description: extrusion depth; a few millimetres for signs on a wall; unit: m

lineSpacing.description: line spacing as a multiple of the line height

letterSpacing.description: extra space between letters as a multiple of the line height

items.description: content path of a material asset (no extension)

materials.description: slot 0: the front faces, slot 1: the sides and the back (the front material when missing)
